theme: Mutual fund literacy: what is an expense ratio, active vs passive, fund categories
headline: Understanding Expense Ratios in Mutual Funds
body: Expense ratios represent annual costs charged by funds. Lower ratios mean more of your money stays invested and working for growth.
caption: Every fund has operational costs for management, administration, and compliance. Comparing expense ratios helps you understand the true cost of investing. Lower costs can compound into meaningful savings over time. #MutualFundLiteracy #ExpenseRatio #InvestingBasics #SmartInvesting #WealthBuilding
